summary: Self-service automation portal gives business users a point-and-click web UI using AAP's logins, security and automation. AAP job templates sync as auto-generated templates with the same forms; custom templates from a git repository map to job templates, several per job template, with RBAC set in the portal.
questions: Can I have more than one custom template per job template?
Where do custom self-service templates come from?

answer_card.title: What is self-service automation portal?
answer_card.answer_md:
A simplified web UI for running AAP automation without knowing playbooks.

- Uses your existing AAP logins, security controls and automation.
- **Auto-generated templates**: AAP job templates synced into the portal, with the same launch forms.
- **Custom templates**: pulled from a git repository; their config file links them to an AAP job template and defines the forms. You can map several to one job template and set their RBAC in the portal.
